{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "ismaelsadeeq",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but objected that delegating template eviction to clients rather than node FIFO eviction could lead to OOM"
    },
    {
      "login": "brunoerg",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "reported unkilled mutant from mutation testing, which was resolved with a test update"
    },
    {
      "login": "ryanofsky",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; raised thread safety mutex requirement on template_tx_refs which was fixed"
    },
    {
      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "approved across multiple rebases; suggested unordered_map and salted hasher for CTransactionRef map keys"
    },
    {
      "login": "enirox001",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "reviewed commit ordering, locking, and ran tests"
    },
    {
      "login": "hebasto",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked about the std::hash parameter type for CTransactionRef"
    },
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "NACKed IWYU workaround in primitives/transaction.h, leading Sjors to move the CTransactionRef hasher to #35101"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:3493499544",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "use internal memory management with a memory budget and FIFO template release rather than relying on IPC clients",
      "quote": "In my opinion, we should not rely on the IPC client to manage our memory.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained internal memory management treats IPC clients no differently than internal code, and FIFO eviction can be a last resort",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3563799563"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3563799563",
      "status_by_quote": "It seems counter intuitive, but from a memory management perspective IPC clients are treated no different than our own code. And if we started FIFO deleting templates that are used by our own code, we'd crash."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3564018931",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "delegating template eviction responsibility to the client can cause out of memory crashes if handled poorly",
      "quote": "Delegating template eviction responsibility to the client can put us in a situation where they handle it poorly and cause us to OOM",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained client responsibility is inherent to multiprocess and FIFO eviction can be used as a fallback if needed",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3570105870"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3570105870",
      "status_by_quote": "In the scenario where they handle it poorly, we can use FIFO deletion. All `getMemoryLoad()` does is give clients an opportunity to handle it better."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2581145624",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add test coverage for the unkilled mutant in template_tx_refs reference counting",
      "quote": "Just ran a mutation testing for this PR and this is the only unkilled mutant - feel free to ignore if it doesn't make sense to address",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author adjusted interface_ipc.py test to cover the mutant, which reviewer confirmed",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2584340016"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2587699846",
      "status_by_quote": "Nice, thank you!"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2590041765",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "template_tx_refs map accessed across multiple threads without synchronization creates data race hazards",
      "quote": "This map can updated from multiple threads, so it needs a mutex to be used safely.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added template_state_mutex",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2592303231"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2592303231",
      "status_by_quote": "To limit the scope of this PR, I only added the mutex, but called it `template_state_mutex` in anticipation."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2590089590",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "ask if there was a particular reason to assert that the bench log message is logged",
      "quote": "Seems ok to assert this log message is logged, but I'm wondering if there was a particular reason for doing this.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained it checks that bench logging happens",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2591987168"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2591987168",
      "status_by_quote": "This just checks that bench logging happens."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2878931110",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "use std::unordered_map instead of std::map since ordered entries are not needed",
      "quote": "std::map has lookup `O(log(size))` whereas `std::unordered_map` has `O(1)`. Here we do not need the entries to be ordered.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched TxTemplateMap to std::unordered_map",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2891914696"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2891914696",
      "status_by_quote": "Done both."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2894597519",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "use custom salted hasher and comparator for CTransactionRef in TxTemplateMap rather than comparing pointers",
      "quote": "it is the same for `map` and `unordered_map` when used with `shared_ptr` (or `CTransactionRef`) - they compare pointers.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted CTransactionRefSaltedHash and CTransactionRefComp",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3050397606",
        "c:4205258678"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:4081459739",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 10acf818ed70d4cd2af864278a35a6b64de0bb16"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3093561704",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "whether std::hash<CTransactionRef> parameter type should be CTransactionRef instead of const CTransactionRef&",
      "quote": "Should this be `CTransactionRef` instead of `const CTransactionRef&`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "maflcko confirmed the docs refer to the logical type; the commit was later moved to #35101",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3100650418",
        "rc:3136909052"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:3101810363"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3101810363",
      "status_by_quote": "No, I am sure the docs just refer to the logical type"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3100806462",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "IWYU workaround in primitives/transaction.h is wrong and harmful",
      "quote": "NACK This is wrong and harmful, as already explained in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35073#issuecomment-4258599969",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "IWYU workaround and CTransactionRef hasher commit moved to #35101 and dropped from this PR",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3100822626",
        "rc:3101139032",
        "rc:3101448908",
        "rc:3101665167",
        "rc:3102893023",
        "c:4270824311"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4270824311",
      "status_by_quote": "The safety commit for `CTransactionRef` and IWYU changes are now in #35101 and dropped from this PR."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:3608940825",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "The `getMemoryLoad()` function seems useful by itself and the underlying tracking would seem to provide almost everything needed to limit memory used by block templates.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3883009585",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "reviewed code c37d715c1d32020fe16ddc92f7ca95f585cc6b4b",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3902381313",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "reviewed code 04553cd6612f08d757fb20287fe111007bfb6db1",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4061578431",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "verified commit ordering, lifetime/locking of template_tx_refs and mempool.cs, and ran interface_ipc_mining.py",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "context.h",
        "mining.h",
        "interfaces.cpp",
        "miner.cpp",
        "interface_ipc_mining.py"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4081459739",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "reviewed code 10acf818ed70d4cd2af864278a35a6b64de0bb16",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4179948443",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "PGP-signed ACK for d37e0fc16c235ff511bd9485ef505f0c5615d9e4",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "reviews on the latest rebase building on top of landed #35675 (BlockTemplateManager)",
      "id": "c:5812662660"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Brought up to date under current rules. Separated ismaelsadeeq's r:3493499544 (suggestion for internal FIFO memory management) from c:3564018931 (objection that delegating eviction risks OOM). Added suggestions and questions from brunoerg, ryanofsky, vasild, and hebasto. The branch was re-architected on top of BlockTemplateManager from #35675 and is awaiting fresh reviews."
}
